paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Keritot 9a](https://www.sefaria.org/Keritot.9a.11), speaking in the name of Rav Ada bar Ahavah.[^1]

notes.text: Both the Bavli and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=405&lang=en) have Rav Idi bar Gershom citing Rav Ada bar Ahavah.
